novelty_search.nearest_result: The raw-text dual program is a zero-forward release over has/had v5 and is/was v6 evidence, not a prospective end-to-end test of the combined interface.
novelty_search.new_question: Does the unchanged selector and both unchanged causal writers preserve A/P effects on two new banks sharing the same new occupation lexicon?

population.rows: 64 has/had v6 plus 64 is/was v7 rows; 16 occupations are identical across banks and disjoint from every prior bank for each task; has/had periods and every row ID are new.
population.capability_first: Score native base/donor answer-versus-foil accuracy in eight family/direction cells per bank. All 16 cells must pass before any intervention outcome is computed or persisted.
population.capability_bars: A1/A2/P cells >=0.85; C cells >=0.75, separately by direction and bank.
population.no_rescue: No row removal, lexical replacement, cue edit, gain refit, basis/rank change, or bar change after execution.

frozen_program.selector: Unchanged six-cue raw-text selector from aspectual_tense.raw_text_dual_program_v1.
frozen_program.read_compute_write: Selected released program reads its exact resid:10 local contrast, applies its four unchanged direction-affine coefficients, and adds alpha times its unchanged unit rank-one basis at resid:18; C abstains.
frozen_program.source_side: base for A1/A2/C and donor for P, matching the prior prospective program semantics.
frozen_program.forbidden: No donor activation in the actuator, final-margin confirmation, per-row root/grid, outcome IDs for gain selection, fitting, or model update.

bars.selector: All 128 intervention-source texts select exact bank/direction for A/P and abstain for C.
bars.A: A1 and A2 mean recovery >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75 separately by bank.
bars.P: Mean margin-reflection fraction >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75 separately by bank.
bars.C: Mean normalized unrelated effect <=0.20 separately by bank; abstention identity must make it exactly zero.
bars.identity: Both bases are unit norm and hash-exact; local and final selected-head controls <=1e-4; all 128 rows retained.

predictions.pred_a_authority_release_basis_and_rows: All hashes, releases, manifests, row authorities, disjointness, basis hashes, and exact heads match.
predictions.pred_b_native_capability_first: All 16 native cells pass before causal outcomes open.
predictions.pred_c_automatic_selector_identity: All 128 source texts route exact bank/direction or C abstention without ambiguity.
predictions.pred_d_prospective_has_had_preservation: Has/had v6 passes A1/A2/P/C bars with the unchanged q_has program.
predictions.pred_e_prospective_is_was_preservation: Is/was v7 passes A1/A2/P/C bars with the unchanged q_is program.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: Four forwards cover 256 native examples and 128 causal records with zero fit/grid/root/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: prospective matched-lexicon evidence supports the automatic dual program within both registered grammars.
terminal.null: Capability and identity pass but at least one program misses its causal bar.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, selector, identity, coverage, finiteness, or price fails; causal outcomes remain sealed if capability fails.
